finding.claim: The /preview endpoint fetches a fully user-supplied URL server-side with no validation. An attacker can reach internal services, cloud metadata (169.254.169.254), localhost, or arbitrary hosts. The first 500 bytes of the response body are returned, so this is a non-blind SSRF.
finding.sink: requests.get(target, timeout=5) at app.py:16; response status and body[:500] returned at app.py:17

trace.note: target is passed directly to requests.get, which also follows redirects by default
Response status and first 500 characters of the body are returned to the attacker

finding.guards_checked: No scheme check, no host allowlist, no private/loopback/link-local IP blocking, no redirect restriction. The ALLOWED_HOSTS check is only applied in /partner, not here.

verdict.reason: app.py:15 reads the user-controlled `url` query parameter and passes it unvalidated to requests.get at app.py:16, and app.py:17 returns the status and first 500 characters of the body. The only host check is in /partner (app.py:24), and no before_request middleware exists.
